notes.title: December 15th Update & Thank you
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers!

Just a quick message to say thanks to all for your great support since we launched The Unexpected Quest. We’ve been really pleased with all of your support, messages, and feedback on the game and it’s great to see so many people are enjoying it. 

Based on your feedback, we’ve made small fixes to the game. Please find the patch notes below.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
If the game does not find a suitable localization, the English language will be set.

Thanks for your amazing support and stay safe!

Cheers!

notes.title: Release date is now confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hi adventurers! 

We're delighted to confirm that the release date for The Unexpected Quest will be November 27th! 

The game will be live in the morning for Europe, late afternoon for Asia and in the night for North America! 

We hope you're as excited as we are and looking forward to playing the full game! 

Don't forget to wishlist the main game!
